[package]
authors = ["1Password"]
categories = ["authentication"]
description = "A one stop library to implement a passkey client and authenticator"
edition = "2024"
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "src/"]
keywords = ["ctap", "fido2", "passkey", "passwordless", "webauthn"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "passkey"
readme = "../README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/1Password/passkey-rs"
rust-version = "1.87.0"
version = "0.5.0"

[package.metadata.cargo-udeps.ignore]
development = ["tokio-test"]

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"
unused-qualifications = "deny"
unused_must_use = "forbid"

[lints.rustdoc]
broken_intra_doc_links = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
as_conversions = "deny"
dbg_macro = "deny"
result_unit_err = "deny"
todo = "deny"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "deny"
unimplemented = "deny"
unused_async = "deny"

[features]
default = []
linux = ["passkey-authenticator/linux", "passkey-client/linux"]
windows = ["passkey-client/windows"]
rust-crypto = ["passkey-crypto/rust-crypto"]
aws-lc-rs = ["passkey-crypto/aws-lc-rs"]

[dependencies.passkey-authenticator]
path = "../passkey-authenticator"
version = "0.6"

[dependencies.passkey-client]
path = "../passkey-client"
version = "0.6"

[dependencies.passkey-transports]
path = "../passkey-transports"
version = "0.2"

[dependencies.passkey-types]
path = "../passkey-types"
version = "0.6"

[dependencies.passkey-crypto]
path = "../passkey-crypto"
version = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
tokio-test = "0.4"
url = "2"

[dev-dependencies.passkey-authenticator]
path = "../passkey-authenticator"
version = "0.6"
features = ["testable", "tokio"]

[dev-dependencies.passkey-client]
path = "../passkey-client"
version = "0.6"
features = ["testable", "tokio"]

[dev-dependencies.passkey-crypto]
path = "../passkey-crypto"
version = "0.1"
features = ["rand"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros", "rt", "rt-multi-thread"]

[package]
authors = ["1Password"]
categories = ["authentication"]
description = "A webauthn authenticator supporting passkeys."
edition = "2024"
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "src/"]
keywords = ["ctap", "fido2", "passkey", "passwordless", "webauthn"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "passkey-authenticator"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/1Password/passkey-rs"
rust-version = "1.87.0"
version = "0.6.0"

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"
unused-qualifications = "deny"
unused_must_use = "forbid"

[lints.rustdoc]
broken_intra_doc_links = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
as_conversions = "deny"
dbg_macro = "deny"
result_unit_err = "deny"
todo = "deny"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "deny"
unimplemented = "deny"
unused_async = "deny"

[features]
default = []
testable = ["dep:mockall", "passkey-types/testable"]
tokio = ["dep:tokio"]
linux = ["dep:tokio", "dep:passkey-transports", "tokio/macros", "passkey-transports/linux"]

[dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.ciborium]
version = "0.2"

[dependencies.mockall]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dependencies.passkey-crypto]
path = "../passkey-crypto"
version = "0.1"

[dependencies.passkey-transports]
path = "../passkey-transports"
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.passkey-types]
path = "../passkey-types"
version = "0.6"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["sync", "macros"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
ciborium = "0.2"
serde_cbor = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies.authenticator]
version = "0.5"
default-features = false
features = ["crypto_dummy"]

[dev-dependencies.generic-array]
version = "=0.14.7"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.mockall]
version = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies.passkey-types]
path = "../passkey-types"
version = "0.6"
features = ["testable"]

[dev-dependencies.signature]
version = "2"
features = ["rand_core"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros", "rt", "sync"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dev-dependencies.winapi]
version = "^0.3"
features = ["std"]

[package]
authors = ["1Password"]
categories = ["authentication"]
description = "Webauthn client in Rust."

[dependencies]

idna = "1"

[dependencies.mockall]

[dependencies.nom]

[dependencies.passkey-authenticator]
path = "../passkey-authenticator"

[dependencies.passkey-crypto]

[dependencies.passkey-types]
path = "../passkey-types"

[dependencies.public-suffix]

[dependencies.reqwest]

[dev-dependencies]
coset = ">=0.3.8, <=0.4"

[dev-dependencies.mockall]
version = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies.passkey-authenticator]
path = "../passkey-authenticator"
version = "0.6"
features = ["testable", "tokio"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros", "rt"]

[package]
authors = ["1Password"]
categories = ["authentication"]
description = "Generic cryptographic backend for the passkey-rs crates"
edition = "2024"
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "src/"]
keywords = ["ctap", "fido2", "passkey", "passwordless", "webauthn"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "passkey-crypto"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/1Password/passkey-rs"
rust-version = "1.87.0"
version = "0.1.0"

[features]
default = ["rust-crypto"]
rand = ["dep:rand", "dep:getrandom"]
js = ["getrandom/wasm_js"]
rust-crypto = ["dep:p256", "dep:ed25519-dalek", "dep:ml-dsa", "dep:signature", "rand", "dep:sha2", "dep:hmac", "dep:zeroize"]
aws-lc-rs = ["dep:aws-lc-rs", "dep:zeroize"]

[dependencies]
coset = ">=0.3.8, <=0.4"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.aws-lc-rs]
version = "1.18"
optional = true

[dependencies.ed25519-dalek]
version = "3.0"
optional = true
features = ["alloc", "rand_core", "pkcs8"]

[dependencies.hmac]
version = "0.13"
optional = true

[dependencies.ml-dsa]
version = "0.1"
optional = true
features = ["pkcs8"]

[dependencies.p256]
version = "0.14"
optional = true
features = ["arithmetic", "pem"]

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.10"
optional = true

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dependencies.signature]
version = "3.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.4"
optional = true
features = ["wasm_js"]

[lints.rust]
missing_docs = "warn"
unused-qualifications = "deny"
unused_must_use = "forbid"

[lints.rustdoc]
broken_intra_doc_links = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
as_conversions = "deny"
dbg_macro = "deny"
result_unit_err = "deny"

undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "deny"
unimplemented = "deny"
unused_async = "deny"

[dev-dependencies.ssh-key]
version = "0.6.7"
features = ["p256", "rsa"]

[dev-dependencies.p256]
version = "0.13.2"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.61"
features = ["derive"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dev-dependencies]
interprocess = "2.4.4"

[[example]]
name = "agent-socket-info"
required-features = ["agent"]

[[example]]
name = "key-storage"
required-features = ["agent"]

[[example]]
name = "proto-dumper"
required-features = ["agent"]

[[example]]
name = "random-key"
required-features = ["agent"]

[[example]]
name = "ssh-agent-client"
required-features = ["agent"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/1password/passkey-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/1password/passkey-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "8a0635474a40d7e54d4ecbeab0979591ea60e17e"

[source."https://github.com/protonpass/proton-pass-common"]
git = "https://github.com/protonpass/proton-pass-common"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "2.1.1"

[source."https://github.com/wiktor-k/ssh-agent-lib"]
git = "https://github.com/wiktor-k/ssh-agent-lib"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "3114e4ee3cbe1f3e2ea187f70b82372789da0fef"

[source.proton-registry]
registry = "sparse+https://rust-registry.proton.me/index/"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
